slides.say: The accompanying figure shows quadrilateral A B C D. Given: angle A is one hundred eighteen degrees, and angle B is ninety-six degrees. Which of the following cannot be the value of alpha?
We know two angles, and the question asks about alpha, the angle at C. The angle at D has no number at all. [short pause] So we'll use the rule that connects all four angles of a quadrilateral.
at: The angle at D has no number

slides.say: [short pause] The angles of every quadrilateral add up to three hundred sixty degrees. Let's call the angle at D beta. So one hundred eighteen, plus ninety-six, plus alpha, plus beta, is three hundred sixty.
at: Let's call the angle at D

slides.say: One hundred eighteen plus ninety-six is two hundred fourteen. Three hundred sixty minus two hundred fourteen is one hundred forty-six. So alpha and beta together are one hundred forty-six.

What does that tell us? The two angles share one hundred forty-six between them. They could be seventy-three each. Or alpha could be one hundred, and beta forty-six. But neither of them can be one hundred forty-six or more. If alpha were one hundred forty-six, beta would be zero, and an angle of zero degrees isn't a real angle. So alpha can't be one hundred forty-six, and choice number four is our answer.
at: and choice number four is our answer

slides.say: In the exam you'd mark it and move on. But here, let's check the other choices too, because one of them hides a trap. Alpha twenty-six gives beta one hundred twenty, together one hundred forty-six, so it's possible. Alpha seventy gives beta seventy-six, also possible.

Now alpha one hundred twenty-four. Some students say, wait, alpha looks acute in the figure, so it can't be one hundred twenty-four. But figures on the exam are not drawn to scale. An angle can be drawn acute and still be obtuse. Alpha one hundred twenty-four gives beta twenty-two, and that's possible too. So only one hundred forty-six is impossible, choice number four. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next question.
at: figures on the exam are not drawn to scale
